objective: Maximize the sum of negative, unrounded original ADF t statistics; no return forecast objective
baseline: The existing original MAX_WEIGHT matching, including its actual unweighted maximum-cardinality behavior
cardinality: Use the original matching count for each month; do not replace it with 100
candidates: Full original matching graph reconstructed with unchanged src.selection.calculate_edges; no p-value threshold, top-N restriction, or extra historical-availability filter
orientation: Keep the original matching orientation for its edges; for other unordered edges use deterministic lexicographic orientation among available directions; never select both directions
score: s_e = -T_STAT, unrounded; this intentionally introduces the proposed score objective and does not claim the original matching used it

training.end: Formation cutoff inclusive; no prices after cutoff in selection/risk features
training.return: Sum original public_arithmetic P&L divided by sum original capital; pair-level NaNs use original nansum behavior
training.zero_capital: Aggregate NaN return is zero solely in the risk estimator, consistent with the source cumulative-return cash convention; saved trading returns retain source NaN
training.budget: Original SOURCE_M variance on the same training dates, shared by all b=1,2,3 variants

optimization.structural_milp_disabled_reason: Full-graph MILP presolve can consume the entire search deadline before any exact risk evaluation; production uses the same local-search budget for all caps
optimization.initial_incumbent: Original baseline, then preceding smaller-cap feasible result
optimization.certificate: Report achieved feasibility and score separately from global optimality; exact nonlinear ratio risk is never replaced with fixed-weight covariance

unchanged: Original price file and full-sample universe
Q magnitude, one-row signal shift, same-day beta, current-price capital denominator
Original NaN arithmetic, inclusive monthly endpoints and duplicate boundary rows
Original performance aggregation and both original reporting scopes
No active trading-cost model: gross results only; no new fee or borrowing convention
outputs: Separate research/adf_risk_selection/output only; original code, input caches, results, checks and reports remain unchanged
interpretation: Controlled source-replay selection comparison. Preserved source timing/accounting limitations prevent treating it as an executable, leakage-free investment backtest. Estimated risk constraint is not an out-of-sample risk guarantee.
